primary_task: For one app, analyze the codebase, generate a render.yaml Blueprint, push it to the Git remote and hand the user a Render Dashboard deeplink to apply it.

requirements.name: git repository pushed to GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket
requirements.evidence: **Git Repo Path:** Required for both Blueprint and Direct Creation. The repo must be pushed to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
requirements.basis: The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy. (github.com is on the egress allow-list; GitLab and Bitbucket are not, so only the GitHub alternative counts.)

requirements.name: git
requirements.evidence: git add render.yaml && git commit -m "Add Render deployment configuration" && git push origin main
requirements.basis: bash: ... build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session

requirements.name: render CLI
requirements.evidence: Validate (recommended): run `render blueprints validate`; If not installed, offer to install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/render-oss/cli/main/bin/install.sh | sh
requirements.basis: GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com) ... are open; bash: GitHub release downloads

requirements.name: Render API key / render login
requirements.evidence: API Key (CLI): `export RENDER_API_KEY="rnd_xxxxx"` ... Login: `render login`; render whoami -o json (only for CLI validation / fallback)
requirements.basis: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, ...)

requirements.name: Render MCP server
requirements.evidence: Direct Creation - Create services instantly via MCP tools; list_services(); 'Use Direct Creation (MCP) when ALL are true' (alternative method; Blueprint does not need it except optional Step 7 verification)
requirements.basis: connectors or integrations other than the tools listed

notes: Reading taken: the deliverable is the render.yaml plus a deeplink the user clicks; Render itself is driven by the user in the Dashboard, so Render credentials/MCP are not needed (Blueprint is the default path). Under the other reading (single service via Direct Creation/MCP, or the agent must itself deploy and verify with list_deploys) the Render MCP/API key is hard and unavailable and the verdict would be BLOCKED. dashboard.render.com is only emitted as a link, not fetched. Unknown: whether the user's repo already has a GitHub remote. Push is to GitHub through the permitted account; if forbid_effects writes_external were read to cover that, the push step would be blocked.
